techParks.name: Bommasandra Industrial Area
techParks.locality: Bommasandra / Hebbagodi, Hosur Road, Anekal Taluk 560099
techParks.description: KIADB's manufacturing estate on Hosur Road immediately south of Electronic City (OSM way/103293015, operator KIADB). Its plots run from Hebbagodi down Hosur Road to Narayana Health City and west along the Bommasandra-Jigani link road (Phase IV), where Biocon Park, Apotex, Atotech and TaeguTec sit; company addresses on that road read 'Bommasandra Industrial Area' even several kilometres from the core polygon. Tenants confirmed from company pages here include Mersen (No. 5 and No. 19), Anthem Biosciences (No. 49 Canara Bank Road), Sansera Engineering (several plants), Micro Labs (three Bommasandra sites), OneSource (#293 Jigani Link Road) and Narayana Health City (258/A); SKF, Delta, Syngene and a Siemens Healthineers construction site are OSM-mapped.

techParks.name: Jigani Industrial Area
techParks.description: KIADB estate at Jigani, south-west of Bommasandra (OSM way/103293010), mixing granite exporters, food and packaging units and small engineering shops with Otis India's plot-92 elevator factory, LAPP India's cable plant, Sansera's Plants 9 and 14 and the Tata composites works where TASL opened an Airbus composite-structures plant in November 2025. Wikipedia's Jigani article also names HCL, APC and Toyota among the firms that brought workers here.

techParks.name: Biocon Park
techParks.description: Biocon's research and biologics-manufacturing campus and SEZ on the Bommasandra-Jigani link road; Wikipedia pictures the Biocon Research Centre inside it, and Syngene International is headquartered here. Mapped in OpenStreetMap as way/545039647 with a 'Biocon' building inside (way/279472179).

techParks.name: HCL Technologies SEZ Jigani
techParks.description: HCLTech's SEZ delivery campus off the Bommasandra-Jigani link road (OSM way/170320607), with an 'HCL Autonomous Car Test Area' mapped inside it; Aragen's biologics plant adjoins it to the west. Wikipedia's Jigani article names HCL among the companies that brought workers to the area.

techParks.name: Attibele Industrial Area
techParks.description: KIADB estate on Hosur Road just short of the Karnataka-Tamil Nadu border at Attibele (OSM way/1119637972), with about 150 mapped plots of auto-component, granite, chemical and engineering units. Michell Bearings (plot 8D) and Sandhar (plots 7A and 12-C) are confirmed from company pages; Ashirvad, Buhler (India), a Faurecia seating plant and Essae-Teraoka are OSM-mapped. Heritage Foods' Yadavanahalli dairy lies just north of it.

coverageNotes: SEARCH LIMIT: the shared WebSearch budget was already exhausted when this lens ran (every WebSearch call returned 'budget used up'), and the Overpass API failed on three mirrors, so discovery used the OSM extracts, the OSM editing API's map call for six small boxes (Bommasandra, the Jigani link road, Hebbagodi, Jigani, Attibele, Chandapura, Kudlu/Singasandra), the geocoder, and direct WebFetch of company pages and Wikipedia. CONFIRMED FROM PRIMARY PAGES: Sansera (10 plants, all listed on its contact page, incl. Bidadi Plant 11), Mersen (No. 5 and No. 19 Bommasandra), Anthem (Unit I), Aragen (Plot 284 Part A biologics plant), OneSource (ex-Stelis) Global R&D at #293 Jigani Link Road, Micro Labs (Bommasandra, Veerasandra, Kumbalgodu, Peenya named but without plot numbers), Ashirvad/Aliaxis registered office, Sandhar (Bommasandra Plot 8, Attibele 7A and 12-C, two Peenya units), Michell Bearings (8D Attibele), Heritage Foods (Yadavanahalli), Essae-Teraoka (Koramangala HQ), Velankani Unit-3 (Rajapura) and Unit-2, Otis (No. 92 Jigani), TASL's Jigani composites plant (Nov 2025), Narayana Health City (258/A), Siemens Healthineers' INR 1,300 cr Bengaluru campus (location from OSM), BGSW's 360 Business Park and Koramangala centres, Atotech's E-City development centre, and the AMR Tech Park tenants Tally, Sagility, Quinnox, Clear plus Softtek and BHIVE. OSM-ONLY, LOW CONFIDENCE: SKF, Delta Electronics, TaeguTec, LAPP, Buhler (India) in Attibele, the Faurecia (FORVIA) seating plant in Attibele, Ashirvad's Attibele plant, Atotech's Bommasandra plant, Apotex Research/Pharmachem (apotex.com 403), Trelleborg (Chikkathoguru), Shahi Exports' Bommanahalli factory, the Mahindra Last Mile Mobility Bommasandra plant (no plot found anywhere; estate centroid), and the OSM-only AMR tenants HGS, Mindteck, MetricStream, Avaya, Visionet and Mando Softtech. COORDINATES: many plots on the Bommasandra-Jigani link road are not mapped, so Sansera's Plants 3/7/8/10, Sandhar's Plot 8 and Ashirvad's HQ share the link-road centroid (12.8010, 77.6618), and Bommasandra or Jigani addresses without a mapped plot share the estate centroids; these are marked park-centroid/photon with medium confidence. CATEGORY CALLS: Narayana Health is MNC (listed, 19,214 employees, Cayman Islands hospital) although other lenses filed it MID_SIZE; Sagility is filed Indian (Bengaluru-headquartered, NSE-listed) where G09 said Foreign; Shahi Exports (100,000+ staff but unlisted) is filed MID_SIZE because the MNC rule for Indian firms requires a listing. OUT OF BOX / OUT OF LENS: Hosur IT Park (OSM way/1338543702 at 12.761, 77.843) and the Ashok Leyland/TVS/Ather/Titan plants are in Hosur, Tamil Nadu, east of the Attibele border check-post, and are excluded; Ola Electric (Krishnagiri), Simple Energy's Shoolagiri plant, Volvo (Hoskote) and Toyota (Bidadi) are outside this lens; Anthem's Units II-III (Harohalli, ~12.68 N), OneSource's Doddaballapura DS/DP site (~13.27 N) and Strides' KRS Gardens plant (Suragajakkanahalli, not geocodable inside the box) are excluded. Britannia, Himalaya, Wipro Consumer Care, Jubilant, ITC, Toshiba, Timken, Yokogawa, Hical and Centum have no Bengaluru presence in this belt that could be found (their sites are in Whitefield, Makali, Sarjapur Road, Yeshwanthpur, E-City or Yelahanka and are covered by other lenses); Ultraviolette's and Simple Energy's Bengaluru offices are covered by E09/G09. NOT CONFIRMED / LEFT OUT: data centres (no operator page or datacentermap listing could be read - datacentermap returned 429, Web Werks 503 - and no data-centre feature exists in OSM in this belt); OSM 'Kirloskar Toyota' works in Jigani (way/722828168; entity - possibly Kirloskar Toyota Textile Machinery - unconfirmed); Suretex Prophylactics, Intermed Labs, Microtrol, BonAyu, Avon Plastic, Shetron, Dove Tail, Times of India press (Bommasandra) and the 150-odd small Attibele/Jigani units (small or unconfirmed); 'Bostik' (only as a landmark in another node's address); Peter England factory node at Hongasandra (could be an outlet); Bosch/RBEI node at Gold Hill Square No. 690 Hosur Road (not on BGSW's current locations page, likely stale); Myntra at AKR Tech Park (BHIVE now labels the building 'previously Myntra HQ'; G02/G09 place Myntra at Embassy TechVillage and the move predates 2023, so it is excluded under the closure rule); Sattva Texonic and IndoSpace (unknown tenants; IndoSpace kept as a park only); emids and CreditBee nodes in Bommanahalli (company pages 404/503; emids is in G15). Bengaluru headcounts were not found for any company and are null.
